name: 60 - API - Start Clinical Intake - Per Clinic Override V2

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::TEXT AS mobile,
        NULLIF($3::BIGINT, 0) AS appointment_id,
        $4::TEXT AS request_goal,
        $5::TEXT AS symptom_category,
        $6::TEXT AS chief_complaint,
        NULLIF($7::TEXT, '') AS duration_text,
        $8::INTEGER AS severity,
        $9::TEXT AS age_group,
        $10::BOOLEAN AS pregnancy_possible,
        $11::BOOLEAN AS is_worsening,
        $12::BOOLEAN AS difficulty_breathing,
        $13::BOOLEAN AS chest_pain,
        $14::BOOLEAN AS loss_of_consciousness,
        $15::BOOLEAN AS seizure,
        $16::BOOLEAN AS severe_bleeding,
        $17::BOOLEAN AS possible_overdose,
        $18::BOOLEAN AS pregnancy_emergency_concern,
        $19::BOOLEAN AS self_harm_or_violence,
        NULLIF($20::TEXT, '') AS chronic_conditions,
        NULLIF($21::TEXT, '') AS current_medications,
        $22::TEXT AS source_channel,
        $23::BOOLEAN AS consent_to_contact,
        $24::BOOLEAN AS consent_to_store_health_information,
        $25::BOOLEAN AS disclaimer_acknowledged
),

clinic_context AS (
    SELECT
        clinic.id AS clinic_id,
        clinic.name AS clinic_name,
        request.*
    FROM request_data request
    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE
    ORDER BY clinic.id
    LIMIT 1
),

patient_context AS (
    SELECT
        patient.id AS patient_id,
        patient.full_name AS patient_name
    FROM patients patient
    INNER JOIN clinic_context context
        ON patient.clinic_id = context.clinic_id
       AND patient.mobile = context.mobile
    LIMIT 1
),

appointment_context AS (
    SELECT
        appointment.id AS appointment_id,
        appointment.service_id,
        appointment.patient_id
    FROM appointments appointment
    INNER JOIN clinic_context context
        ON appointment.clinic_id = context.clinic_id
       AND appointment.id = context.appointment_id
    LEFT JOIN patients appointment_patient
        ON appointment_patient.id = appointment.patient_id
    WHERE context.appointment_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
            appointment_patient.mobile = context.mobile
            OR appointment.patient_id = (
                SELECT patient_id
                FROM patient_context
            )
          )
    LIMIT 1
),

valid_context AS (
    SELECT context.*
    FROM clinic_context context
    WHERE context.appointment_id IS NULL
       OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM appointment_context
       )
),

risk_context AS (
    SELECT
        context.*,

        CASE
            WHEN context.difficulty_breathing = TRUE
              OR context.chest_pain = TRUE
              OR context.loss_of_consciousness = TRUE
              OR context.seizure = TRUE
              OR context.severe_bleeding = TRUE
              OR context.possible_overdose = TRUE
              OR context.pregnancy_emergency_concern = TRUE
              OR context.self_harm_or_violence = TRUE
              OR context.severity = 10
                THEN 'urgent'

            WHEN context.severity >= 8
              OR context.is_worsening = TRUE
                THEN 'high'

            WHEN context.severity >= 5
              OR context.pregnancy_possible = TRUE
                THEN 'medium'

            ELSE 'low'
        END AS risk_level

    FROM valid_context context
),

inserted_case AS (
    INSERT INTO clinical_intake_cases (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        appointment_id,
        service_id,
        contact_mobile,
        source_channel,
        request_goal,
        symptom_category,
        chief_complaint,
        duration_text,
        severity,
        age_group,
        pregnancy_possible,
        is_worsening,
        difficulty_breathing,
        chest_pain,
        loss_of_consciousness,
        seizure,
        severe_bleeding,
        possible_overdose,
        pregnancy_emergency_concern,
        self_harm_or_violence,
        chronic_conditions,
        current_medications,
        risk_level,
        recommended_route,
        status,
        consent_to_contact,
        consent_to_store_health_information,
        disclaimer_acknowledged
    )
    SELECT
        context.clinic_id,
        (
            SELECT patient_id
            FROM patient_context
        ),
        (
            SELECT appointment_id
            FROM appointment_context
        ),
        (
            SELECT service_id
            FROM appointment_context
        ),
        context.mobile,
        context.source_channel,
        context.request_goal,
        context.symptom_category,
        context.chief_complaint,
        context.duration_text,
        context.severity,
        context.age_group,
        context.pregnancy_possible,
        context.is_worsening,
        context.difficulty_breathing,
        context.chest_pain,
        context.loss_of_consciousness,
        context.seizure,
        context.severe_bleeding,
        context.possible_overdose,
        context.pregnancy_emergency_concern,
        context.self_harm_or_violence,
        context.chronic_conditions,
        context.current_medications,
        context.risk_level,

        CASE context.risk_level
            WHEN 'urgent'
                THEN 'emergency_services'
            WHEN 'high'
                THEN 'urgent_clinic'
            WHEN 'medium'
                THEN 'doctor_review'
            ELSE 'routine_appointment'
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN context.risk_level IN ('urgent', 'high')
                THEN 'escalated'
            ELSE 'collecting_information'
        END,

        context.consent_to_contact,
        context.consent_to_store_health_information,
        context.disclaimer_acknowledged

    FROM risk_context context
    RETURNING *
),

upserted_handoff AS (
    INSERT INTO human_handoff_tasks (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        appointment_id,
        task_type,
        source_type,
        source_record_id,
        priority,
        status,
        reason,
        due_at
    )
    SELECT
        intake.clinic_id,
        intake.patient_id,
        intake.appointment_id,
        'clinical_triage',
        'clinical_intake',
        intake.id,

        CASE intake.risk_level
            WHEN 'urgent' THEN 'urgent'
            WHEN 'high' THEN 'high'
            ELSE 'normal'
        END,

        'open',

        CONCAT(
            'بررسی پرسش تخصصی اولیه. سطح ریسک: ',
            intake.risk_level,
            '. شرح بیمار: ',
            intake.chief_complaint
        ),

        CASE intake.risk_level
            WHEN 'urgent' THEN NOW()
            WHEN 'high' THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '1 hour'
            ELSE NOW() + INTERVAL '4 hours'
        END

    FROM inserted_case intake
    WHERE intake.risk_level IN ('urgent', 'high')

    ON CONFLICT (
        source_type,
        source_record_id,
        task_type
    )
    WHERE source_record_id IS NOT NULL

    DO UPDATE SET
        priority = EXCLUDED.priority,
        reason = EXCLUDED.reason,
        due_at = LEAST(
            COALESCE(
                human_handoff_tasks.due_at,
                EXCLUDED.due_at
            ),
            EXCLUDED.due_at
        ),
        status = CASE
            WHEN human_handoff_tasks.status = 'cancelled'
                THEN 'open'
            ELSE human_handoff_tasks.status
        END,
        updated_at = NOW()

    RETURNING *
),

linked_case AS (
    UPDATE clinical_intake_cases intake
    SET
        handoff_task_id = handoff.id,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM upserted_handoff handoff
    WHERE intake.id = handoff.source_record_id
    RETURNING intake.*
),

applicable_templates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (
        intake.id,
        template.question_code
    )
        intake.id AS intake_id,
        template.id AS question_template_id,
        template.question_code,
        template.question_text_fa,
        template.question_text_en,
        template.question_text_ar,
        template.answer_type,
        template.options_json,
        template.required,
        template.maps_to_case_field,
        template.risk_if_true,
        template.sort_order,
        template.clinic_id

    FROM inserted_case intake

    INNER JOIN clinical_intake_question_templates template
        ON template.active = TRUE
       AND (
            template.clinic_id IS NULL
            OR template.clinic_id = intake.clinic_id
       )
       AND LOWER(template.symptom_category) IN (
            'general',
            LOWER(intake.symptom_category)
       )

    ORDER BY
        intake.id,
        template.question_code,
        CASE
            WHEN template.clinic_id = intake.clinic_id
                THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END,
        template.id DESC
),

question_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        template.question_template_id,
        template.question_code,

        CASE
            WHEN intake.source_channel = 'api'
                THEN COALESCE(
                    template.question_text_en,
                    template.question_text_fa
                )
            ELSE template.question_text_fa
        END AS question_text,

        template.answer_type,
        template.options_json,
        template.required,
        template.risk_if_true,
        template.sort_order

    FROM inserted_case intake

    INNER JOIN applicable_templates template
        ON template.intake_id = intake.id

    WHERE
        CASE template.maps_to_case_field
            WHEN 'duration_text'
                THEN intake.duration_text IS NULL
            WHEN 'severity'
                THEN intake.severity IS NULL
            WHEN 'pregnancy_possible'
                THEN intake.pregnancy_possible IS NULL
            WHEN 'is_worsening'
                THEN intake.is_worsening IS NULL
            WHEN 'difficulty_breathing'
                THEN intake.difficulty_breathing IS NULL
            WHEN 'chest_pain'
                THEN intake.chest_pain IS NULL
            WHEN 'loss_of_consciousness'
                THEN intake.loss_of_consciousness IS NULL
            WHEN 'seizure'
                THEN intake.seizure IS NULL
            WHEN 'severe_bleeding'
                THEN intake.severe_bleeding IS NULL
            WHEN 'possible_overdose'
                THEN intake.possible_overdose IS NULL
            WHEN 'pregnancy_emergency_concern'
                THEN intake.pregnancy_emergency_concern IS NULL
            WHEN 'self_harm_or_violence'
                THEN intake.self_harm_or_violence IS NULL
            WHEN 'chronic_conditions'
                THEN intake.chronic_conditions IS NULL
            WHEN 'current_medications'
                THEN intake.current_medications IS NULL
            ELSE TRUE
        END

    ORDER BY
        template.required DESC,
        template.sort_order,
        template.question_template_id

    LIMIT 8
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
            WHERE appointment_id IS NOT NULL
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM appointment_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inserted_case
        )
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN 'clinic_not_found'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
            WHERE appointment_id IS NOT NULL
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM appointment_context
        )
            THEN 'appointment_not_found_or_mobile_mismatch'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inserted_case
            WHERE risk_level = 'urgent'
        )
            THEN 'urgent_clinical_intake_created'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inserted_case
            WHERE risk_level = 'high'
        )
            THEN 'high_risk_clinical_intake_created'

        ELSE 'clinical_intake_created'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN 'کلینیک مطابق ورودی پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
            WHERE appointment_id IS NOT NULL
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM appointment_context
        )
            THEN 'نوبت مطابق شماره موبایل و کلینیک پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inserted_case
            WHERE risk_level = 'urgent'
        )
            THEN 'درخواست ثبت شد. علائم اعلام‌شده نیازمند ارزیابی فوری هستند؛ بیمار نباید منتظر پاسخ خودکار بماند.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inserted_case
            WHERE risk_level = 'high'
        )
            THEN 'درخواست ثبت و برای بررسی سریع انسانی ارجاع شد.'

        ELSE 'درخواست ثبت شد و سؤالات تکمیلی آماده‌اند.'
    END AS message,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM inserted_case
    ) AS clinical_intake_case_id,

    (
        SELECT patient_id
        FROM inserted_case
    ) AS patient_id,

    (
        SELECT risk_level
        FROM inserted_case
    ) AS risk_level,

    (
        SELECT recommended_route
        FROM inserted_case
    ) AS recommended_route,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM inserted_case
    ) AS case_status,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM upserted_handoff
    ) AS handoff_task_id,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'question_template_id',
                        question_template_id,
                    'question_code',
                        question_code,
                    'question_text',
                        question_text,
                    'answer_type',
                        answer_type,
                    'options',
                        options_json,
                    'required',
                        required,
                    'risk_if_true',
                        risk_if_true
                )
                ORDER BY sort_order, question_template_id
            )
            FROM question_candidates
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS next_questions,

    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inserted_case
            WHERE risk_level = 'urgent'
        )
            THEN 'seek_immediate_local_emergency_help_and_human_review'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inserted_case
            WHERE risk_level = 'high'
        )
            THEN 'human_review'

        ELSE 'collect_intake_answers'
    END AS next_action

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## شروع پرسش تخصصی اولیه

این Workflow اطلاعات اولیه را ثبت و فقط سطح ارجاع عملیاتی را مشخص می‌کند.

کارهایی که انجام نمی‌دهد:
- تشخیص پزشکی
- تجویز یا تغییر درمان
- اطمینان‌دادن پزشکی بدون بررسی متخصص

در ریسک بالا یا فوری، تسک انسانی ساخته می‌شود. در سایر موارد، سؤالات تکمیلی از دیتابیس برگردانده می‌شوند.
